title: TalentOnChain
tagline: TalentOnChain is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO). job listings on TalentOnChain are of high quality and integrity, creating a more efficient and effective talent management system.
description:
In a traditional talent management system, businesses and organizations are responsible for creating and posting job listings. This process is often fraught with problems, as fake or misleading listings can slip through the cracks and waste both the time and resources of job seekers.

The TalentOnChain platform solves this problem by empowering its members with the ability to participate in a decentralized decision-making process. The members can vote on job listings, identifying and removing fake or misleading listings before they are posted.

This process is highly effective in maintaining the quality and integrity of the job listings on the platform. By leveraging the collective knowledge and expertise of its members, the TalentOnChain platform is able to identify and remove fraudulent or misleading listings quickly and efficiently.
how_its_made:
How It's Made : 
* core - Smart contracts incorporating DAO onboarding and governance.
* frontend - Next.js/TypeScript-based frontend dApp
* Scroll - for deploying contracts
* Testnets - Scroll Alpha Testnet

Technologies : 
* UI - Next.js, React, HTML/Tailwind CSS
* Smart Contracts - Solidity deployed on Scroll
* Backend - TypeScript
* Testnet - Scroll Alpha Testnet
* Tools - Hardhat, Remix, Metamask
* Art Design - Adobe PhotoShop, Adobe Illustrator
* Connext - for Bridging SBT's across multiple chains
